items.name: Hotel Stationery — Cards & Envelopes
items.reference: Like your Badrutt's desk set: bordered correspondence cards with a small crest and matching envelopes, in cream/soft tones. (Embossing/foil on paper is a supplier job, not in-house.) Open any card's 'Learn more' for how that service works and what to watch for.
items.note: More big players: Crane & Co. 100% cotton bordered cards + envelopes, box of 10, $32–34 (crane.com — photos hotlink-protected, so not shown). CatPrint (catprint.com) — no minimum, real foil stamping + matching envelopes, open to small businesses (foil is email-to-order; request a card quote). Vistaprint — cheapest high-volume, min 1, but no foil/emboss on flat cards.

options.name: Bordered Correspondence Cards + Envelopes
options.specs: Bordered card · raised-ink your crest/text · white/ivory + red/navy/green border · 6.25×4.5″
options.brand: Supplier raised-ink print of your crest
options.why: Bordered hotel-style cards with your crest printed and matching envelopes included, at a low 25 minimum — the closest turnkey branded match to the Badrutt's set.
options.learn:
How it worksYou choose card color (white/ivory/blue), border color (red/navy/green), a typeface and ink color, and upload your crest + wording. They print by raised-ink thermography — a clear resin is fused over the ink so the design sits raised and glossy (the engraved look at a fraction of the cost). Matching printed envelopes are included.What to know
  • 1 box = 25 cards + 25 envelopes, $75 (~$3/card) — that's the minimum.
  • Raised-ink is one ink color per design — ideal for a single-color seal.
  • Envelope return-address printing is an add-on.
  • Production ~21–28 business days + shipping, so order ahead.
  • Card 6.25×4.5″; optional lined envelopes.
Pro tipIvory stock + a warm-black ink reads most Hill-Country. Raised-ink isn't a true deboss (the back stays flat), but it's the best value for a printed crest.

options.name: Luxe Note Cards (big-player, modern)
options.specs: Mohawk Superfine 32pt · colored seam (8 colors) · A6 · digital crest
options.brand: Supplier digital print (foil via MOO Foil Invitations)
options.why: The big, easy, modern printer — upload your crest, live pricing, ships in ~2 days, envelopes free. Use MOO Foil Invitations for a true gold-foil crest.
options.learn:
How it worksMOO is the big, modern, self-serve printer — online editor, upload your art, live price calculator, fast turnaround. The premium card is Luxe Note Cards: flat A6 cards on Mohawk Superfine 32pt with a colored seam through the middle (8 colors) and free white envelopes, minimum 10.What to know
  • Luxe Note Cards ≈ $2.21/card at 100 (min 10), envelopes free, ships ~2 business days, no setup fee.
  • Foil & letterpress are NOT on note cards — only business cards & invitations. For a true gold-foil crest on a flat A6 card, order MOO Foil Invitations (≈ $2.01/card at 100, no die fee).
  • Foil art needs a separate B&W vector PDF marking the foil area, and foil must cover under 50% of the card (accents, not solid blocks).
  • Printfinity: every card in a pack can be a different design at no charge.
Pro tipUse Luxe Note Cards for an everyday crested card; switch to Foil Invitations when you want the gold-foil hotel look — both include envelopes with no die fee.

options.name: Embossed Border Correspondence Cards (#3120)
options.specs: Embossed raised border + personalization · white/ivory · envelopes included · 6.25×4.5″
options.why: A true embossed border plus your printed crest at the lowest branded price — the most 'embossed' look of the set.
options.learn:
How it worksA long-running US social-stationery house. You pick the embossed border style and add your crest/wording; they emboss the border (an inkless raised relief pressed into the paper) and print your personalization. Matching envelopes included.What to know
  • $55.95 / box of 25 (~$2.24/card), minimum 1 box — the cheapest branded route.
  • Embossing = a tactile raised frame with no ink; subtle and elegant.
  • White or ivory; card 6.25×4.5″.
  • Typical lead time ~1–2 weeks.
Pro tipThe embossed border gives the 'fine hotel' feel cheaply; pair it with a small printed crest. Best for a larger in-room run without a big spend.

options.name: A7 Ecru Embossed Panel Cards (blank)
options.specs: Blind-embossed panel border · ecru · 80lb · blank, laser/inkjet printable
options.why: The cheapest path — premium blind-embossed bordered blanks you run your own crest onto (or letterpress).
options.learn:
How it worksThe DIY blank path: buy premium blind-embossed panel cards (a raised frame + recessed center panel, no ink) and add your crest yourself — run them through a laser/inkjet printer, hand-stamp them, or take them to a local letterpress for a foil/letterpress crest.What to know
  • $14.78 / 50 (~$0.30/card); matching A7 envelopes are separate (~$8.91/25).
  • 80lb cover, ecru, smooth wood-pulp (not cotton); A7 = 5⅛×7″; acid-free.
  • The blind-embossed panel reads upscale even before you add anything.
Pro tipCheapest path and full control. For the richest result, have a local letterpress foil-stamp your seal into the panel — you supply the blanks, they run the die.
